Introduction. Fuling shamans are aggressive creatures found in Plains occupying Fuling villages. They are ritualistic, goblin-like beings that appear to possess their own tribalistic culture. It is implied through runestones and totems that they worship Yagluth, a long dead king.

Protect. Casts a protective barrier over all allies within a 6-meter radius, negating up to 100 damage before breaking or lasting for up to 40 seconds. This ability has a 40-second cooldown and can be used within 60 meters of a player.

Poke. Jabs the player with their feather staff, reaching out 2 meters and creating a 40-degree horizontal arc (100 Blunt damage). This ability has a 2-second cooldown and can be used within 1.5 meters of a player.

Fireball. Shoots a fireball at the player, which applies the Burning status (20 Blunt and 100 Fire damage). The projectile travels at 15 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 4–20 degrees. This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used when within 0–20 meters of a player.

Notes. • In ancient Norse societies, shamanism was associated with Seiðr, a form of magic related to the telling and shaping of the future.
